name: 1Lookup API
description:
One API key and one shared credit balance across every product. Most lookups cost 1 credit and answer in under a second.

Every response uses the same envelope: `{ "success": true, "data": { ... } }` on success and
`{ "success": false, "error": { "message", "code", "type" } }` on failure. Check `success` before reading `data`.

Agents can also reach these lookups over the hosted MCP server at https://app.1lookup.io/api/mcp instead of REST;
connection details are in the MCP server card at https://www.1lookup.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
